22328-oh-you-tex.title: Oh, You Tex!
22328-oh-you-tex.creator: William Macleod Raine
22328-oh-you-tex.description: A book by William Macleod Raine. The tin cup beat time against the tin plate to accompany a kind of shuffling dance. Jack Roberts was fifty miles from nowhere, alone on the desert, but the warm blood of youth set his feet to moving. Why should he not dance? He was one and twenty, stood five feet eleven in his socks, and weighed one hundred and seventy pounds of bone, sinew, and well-packed muscle.

arxiv-1902-05334.title: Security and Privacy Preserving Data Aggregation in Cloud Computing Conference: SAC 2017, April 03 - 07, 2017, Marrakech, Morocco
arxiv-1902-05334.creator: Leandro Ventura Silva, Rodolfo Marinho, Jose Luis Vivas, Andrey Brito
arxiv-1902-05334.description: Abstract Smart metering is an essential feature of smart grids, allowing residential customers to monitor and reduce electricity costs. Devices called smart meters allows residential customers to monitor and reduce electricity costs, promoting energy saving, demand management, and energy efficiency.

arxiv-2103-03941.title: Flat and Correlated Plasmon Bands in Graphene/ α \alpha -RuCl 3 Heterostructures
arxiv-2103-03941.creator: Hui-Ke Jin, J. Knolle
arxiv-2103-03941.description: Abstract We develop a microscopic theory for plasmon excitations of graphene/ α \alpha -RuCl 3 heterostructures. Within a Kondo-Kitaev model with various interactions, a heavy Fermi liquid hosting flat bands emerges in which the itinerant electrons of graphene effectively hybridize with the fractionalized fermions of the Kitaev quantum spin liquid.

arxiv-2103-04827.title: Spatiotemporal linear stability of viscoelastic free shear flows: non-affine response regime
arxiv-2103-04827.creator: D. Bansal † \dagger, D. Ghosh † \dagger, S. Sircar † , ‡ \dagger,\ddagger
arxiv-2103-04827.description: Abstract We provide a detailed comparison of the two-dimensional, temporal and the spatiotemporal linearized analyses of the viscoelastic free shear flows in the limit of low to moderate Reynolds number and Elasticity number obeying four different types of stress-strain constitutive equations: Oldroyd-B, Upper Convected Maxwell, Johnson-Segalman (JS) and linear Phan-Thien Tanner (PTT).

arxiv-2109-08087.title: Mildly Flavoring domain walls in SU(N) SQCD: baryons and monopole superpotentials
arxiv-2109-08087.creator: Sergio Benvenuti, Paolo Spezzati
arxiv-2109-08087.description: Abstract We study supersymmetric domain walls of four dimensional S ​ U ​ ( N ) SU(N) SQCD with N N and N + 1 N+1 flavors. In 4 ​ d 4d we analyze the BPS differential equations numerically. In 3 ​ d 3d we propose the 𝒩 = 1 \mathcal{N}=1 Chern-Simons-Matter gauge theories living on the walls.

arxiv-2305-17218.title: Meta-MeTTa: an operational semantics for MeTTa
arxiv-2305-17218.creator: Lucius Gregory Meredith, Ben Goertzel, Jonathan Warrell, Adam Vandervorst
arxiv-2305-17218.description: Abstract We present an operational semantics for the language MeTTa. 1 Introduction and motivation We present the operational semantics for the language MeTTa. MeTTa is designed as a language in which humans and AGIs write the behavior of AGIs, being jointly developed by SingularityNet.io and F1R3FLY.io, as part of SingularityNet.

arxiv-2306-10555.title: Summarization from Leaderboards to Practice: Choosing A Representation Backbone and Ensuring Robustness
arxiv-2306-10555.creator: David Demeter, Oshin Agarwal, Simon Ben Igeri, Marko Sterbentz, Neil Molino, John M. Conroy, Ani Nenkova
arxiv-2306-10555.description: Abstract Academic literature does not give much guidance on how to build the best possible customer-facing summarization system from existing research components. Here we present analyses to inform the selection of a system backbone from popular models; we find that in both automatic and human evaluation, BART performs better than PEGASUS and T5.

arxiv-2312-12046.title: Pulsation modelling of the Cepheid Y Ophiuchi with RSP/MESA
arxiv-2312-12046.creator: V. Hocdé, R. Smolec, P. Moskalik, R. Singh Rathour, O. Ziółkowska
arxiv-2312-12046.description: Abstract Context. Y Ophiuchi (Y Oph) is a classical Cepheid with a pulsation period of P = P= 17.12 days. This star is reported to be as dim as a Cepheid of about half its pulsation period, and exhibits a low radial velocity and light-curves amplitude.

arxiv-2504-00194.title: Identifying Sparsely Active Circuits Through Local Loss Landscape Decomposition
arxiv-2504-00194.creator: Brianna Chrisman, Lucius Bushnaq, Lee Sharkey
arxiv-2504-00194.description: Abstract Much of mechanistic interpretability has focused on understanding the activation spaces of large neural networks. However, activation space-based approaches reveal little about the underlying circuitry used to compute features. To better understand the circuits employed by models, we introduce a new decomposition method called Local Loss Landscape Decomposition (L3D) .

arxiv-2602-03103.title: Task–Specificity Score: Measuring How Much Instructions Really Matter for Supervision
arxiv-2602-03103.creator: Pritam Kadasi, Abhishek Upperwal, Mayank Singh
arxiv-2602-03103.description: Abstract Instruction tuning is now the default way to train and adapt large language models, but many instruction–input–output pairs are only weakly specified: for a given input, the same output can remain plausible under several alternative instructions. This raises a simple question: does the instruction uniquely determine the target output?

arxiv-2602-16541.description: Abstract . Click models are a central component of learning and evaluation in recommender systems, yet most existing models are designed for single ranked-list interfaces. In contrast, modern recommender platforms increasingly use complex interfaces such as carousels, which consist of multiple swipeable lists that enable complex user browsing behaviors.

plos-pbio-0020050.creator: Haoxing Xu, Jie Jin, Louis J DeFelice et al.
plos-pbio-0020050.description: PLOS ONE research article. Divalent metal transporter-1 (DMT1/DCT1/Nramp2) is the major Fe 2+ transporter mediating cellular iron uptake in mammals. Phenotypic analyses of animals with spontaneous mutations in DMT1 indicate that it functions at two distinct sites, transporting dietary iron across the apica

pmc-10654703.title: Canada Source Watershed Polygons (Can-SWaP): A dataset for the protection of Canada’s municipal water supply
pmc-10654703.creator: François-Nicolas Robinne, Chloé Lamache, Daniel K. Thompson, Jason A. Leach, Kevin D. Bladon
pmc-10654703.description: Over 80% of municipal (i.e., excluding industrial and agricultural) water use in Canada comes from streams, lakes, and reservoirs. These freshwater bodies and their catchments require adequate protection to secure drinking water supply for Canadians. Canada, like most countries, lacks a consolidated national dataset of municipal catchments, arguably due to gaps in data availability.

pmc-10721182.title: Trichinella spiralis cathepsin L damages the tight junctions of intestinal epithelial cells and mediates larval invasion
pmc-10721182.creator: Ruo Dan Liu, Xiang Yu Meng, Chen Le Li, Xin Zhi Lin, Qiu Yi Xu, Han Xu, Shao Rong Long, Jing Cui, Zhong Quan Wang, Francesca Tamarozzi, Krystyna Cwiklinski, Francesca Tamarozzi, Krystyna Cwiklinski, Francesca Tamarozzi, Krystyna Cwiklinski, Francesca Tamarozzi, Krystyna Cwiklinski
pmc-10721182.description: BackgroundCathepsin L, a lysosomal enzyme, participates in diverse physiological processes. Recombinant Trichinella spiralis cathepsin L domains (rTsCatL2) exhibited natural cysteine protease activity and hydrolyzed host immunoglobulin and extracellular matrix proteins in vitro, but its functions in larval invasion are unknown. The aim of this study was to explore its functions in T. spiralis invasion of the host’s intestinal epithelial cells.

pmc-11352350.title: The Influence of Cecal Microbiota Transplantation on Chicken Injurious Behavior: Perspective in Human Neuropsychiatric Research
pmc-11352350.creator: Yuechi Fu, Heng-Wei Cheng
pmc-11352350.description: Numerous studies have evidenced that neuropsychiatric disorders (mental illness and emotional disturbances) with aggression (or violence) pose a significant challenge to public health and contribute to a substantial economic burden worldwide. Especially, social disorganization (or social inequality) associated with childhood adversity has long-lasting effects on mental health, increasing the risk of developing neuropsychiatric disorders.

pmc-11476753.title: Current Research for Heart Disease Biology and Therapeutics
pmc-11476753.creator: Claudia Kusmic
pmc-11476753.description: ith other conditions, possibly leading to a more significant pathological outcome, including severe HF. Heart failure is a significant public health challenge due to its high prevalence and severe impact on patients and healthcare systems. It affects about 2% of the global population and is expected to increase due to ageing populations and improved survival rates from other cardiac conditions.

pmc-11531517.title: Decoupling control strategy of three-port DC–DC converter based on model prediction
pmc-11531517.creator: Junrui Wang, Xuanjing Qiao, Linhui Li, Rui Wang, Hao Qin
pmc-11531517.description: Due to the use of multi winding high-frequency isolation transformers in the three port isolated bidirectional DC–DC converter to achieve port isolation and power transmission, there is a power coupling problem between each port. This article proposes a Model Prediction Control (MPC) strategy to address this issue.

pmc-12583458.title: Keratoconus prevalence in astigmatic adolescents: findings from a nationwide screening setting
pmc-12583458.creator: Margarita Safir, Itay Nitzan, Yair Hanina, Dan Heller, Michael Mimouni, Nir Sorkin
pmc-12583458.description: ObjectivesTo assess the association between varying levels of astigmatism and the likelihood of keratoconus diagnosis in adolescents.MethodsThis cross-sectional study included 896,377 adolescents aged 16–20 years who underwent a standardised medical assessment between 2011 and 2022, including refraction and topography/tomography in cases where astigmatism above 2.00 dioptres (D) was observed. Astigmatism was categorised into five groups: None, 0.75− < 2.

pmc-12743463.title: Endoplasmic Reticulum-Targeting Natural Compounds: A Novel Frontier in Alleviating Liver Fibrosis
pmc-12743463.creator: Chengrong Huang, Wei Hu, Jia Qi, Bolun Su, Hongrui Yan, Yi Zhun Zhu
pmc-12743463.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Liver fibrosis, a reversible yet critical stage in chronic liver disease progression, poses a significant global health burden with limited therapeutic options. This review comprehensively explores the molecular mechanisms of endoplasmic reticulum (ER) stress and its dual role in both parenchymal and non-parenchymal cells during liver fibrosis, alongside the therapeutic potential of natural compounds that target ER stress to alleviate fibrosis. Emerging evidence underscores ER stress and oxidative stress as pivotal drivers of hepatic fibrogenesis, primarily through activating hepatic stellate cells (HSCs).

pmc-13045090.title: Sichuan pepper, Zanthoxylum bungeanum Maxim., suppresses human coronavirus OC43 infection by inhibiting viral entry and impairing autolysosome accumulation
pmc-13045090.creator: Hyeonjeong Park, In Jin Ha, Young-Hee Jin, Sunoh Kwon
pmc-13045090.description: BackgroundThe dried pericarp of Zanthoxylum bungeanum Maxim. (Rutaceae), widely recognized as Sichuan pepper (Hua Jiao), is a prominent herb within the Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM), boasting a long and well-documented history of ethnopharmacological application. Its traditional uses primarily involve the internal management of gastrointestinal ailments, such as stomachaches, alongside promoting systemic blood circulation.

pmc-13068954.title: Elucidation and functional characterization of the biosynthetic pathway of the natural sweetener phyllodulcin in Hydrangea macrophylla
pmc-13068954.creator: Goutham Padmakumar Sarala, Frauke Engel, Anja Hartmann, Nicolaus von Wirén, Mohammad-Reza Hajirezaei
pmc-13068954.description: Among the various natural products found in Hydrangea species, the bioactive dihydroisocoumarin, phyllodulcin (PD) stands out as a non-caloric, high-intensity sweetener, which is up to 800 times sweeter than sucrose. Additionally, PD possesses medicinal properties and plays plant-specific roles in pathogen resistance and abiotic stress tolerance. However, the biosynthetic pathway of PD in Hydrangea has remained unexplored.

pmc-13106081.title: Optimizing pathological diagnosis of tuberculosis: qPCR outperforms acid-fast staining in formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded tissues and enables resistance profiling
pmc-13106081.creator: Yan Hu, Peng Liu, Minhui Mei, Chao Quan, Qiliang Liu
pmc-13106081.description: Background and ObjectiveAccurate detection of Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB) in formalin-fixed paraffin-embedded (FFPE) tissues remains a significant challenge in routine pathological practice. This study aimed to evaluate the performance of the first National Medical Products Administration (NMPA)-approved quantitative polymerase chain reaction (qPCR) kit specifically optimized for FFPE tissues.

pmc-13224134.title: “Hantavirus at sea: Why cruise ships must be ready for animal-borne disease.”
pmc-13224134.creator: Nasro Salad Ahmed, Fardowso Hassan Mohamud, Fatima Abdijabbar Ibrahim, Anisa Hassan Elmi, Yakub Burhan Abdullahi
pmc-13224134.description: e ships are engineered to manage predictable viral threats, such as norovirus and COVID-19, yet remain dangerously exposed to high-fatality, environmentally transmitted zoonoses sustained by rodent reservoirs [3]. Treating this event as an outlier misses its real significance: it is an early stress test of a system unready for the next wave of rodent-borne disease at sea [1,4].

pmc-13371311.title: Colonic pleomorphic undifferentiated sarcoma with a leukemoid reaction: case report
pmc-13371311.creator: Ruizhi Wang, Tao Shan, Dong Mu, Jiayi Cheng, Baoguang Hu, Fengjie Wu
pmc-13371311.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundUndifferentiated pleomorphic sarcoma (UPS) is an aggressive mesenchymal tumor that typically occurs in the extremities or retroperitoneum. Primary colonic involvement is relatively rare, and those accompanied by a leukemoid reaction are even rarer. This case of primary colonic UPS with a significant leukemoid reaction highlights the unique nature of this rare paraneoplastic syndrome, which may mimic hematologic malignancy and delay appropriate surgical intervention.

pmc-13495271.title: “I decide for myself. I’m like the boss of myself. I can cook when I want.” Prisoners’ experiences with a self-catering food system in a Norwegian low-security prison
pmc-13495271.creator: Astrid Kolderup Hervik, Stein Egil Kolderup Hervik
pmc-13495271.description: BackgroundFood is a central part of everyday life in prison, carrying meanings and values that shape identity and social relations and may have important implications for health and well-being. Previous research suggests that self-catering systems, whereby prisoners plan, shop for, and prepare their own meals, may increase opportunities for agency, participation, and health promotion.

pmc-13587006.title: Advances in protein microarray–based proteomics for gastric cancer applications in biomarker discovery, molecular subtyping, and precision oncology
pmc-13587006.creator: Panning Wang, Yu-Lin Xiao, Shuhong Luo, Hua Dong, Ruo-Pan Huang
pmc-13587006.description: Gastric cancer remains a major cause of cancer-related mortality worldwide, largely due to late diagnosis and pronounced molecular heterogeneity. Although genomic and transcriptomic studies have advanced understanding of gastric tumor biology, they do not fully capture dynamic changes in protein expression, post-translational modifications, and signaling activity that directly regulate cellular function.

pmc-13673978.title: Inflatable mediastinoscopic esophagectomy for refractory benign esophageal fistulas: An effective therapeutical methods
pmc-13673978.creator: Changchun Wang, Liwei Xu, Weitian Wei, Qiong He, Kelong Shao, Tianxing Ying, Weimin Mao, Qixun Chen
pmc-13673978.description: ObjectiveFor refractory benign esophageal fistulas unresponsive to endoscopic therapy, inflatable mediastinoscopic esophagectomy with primary reconstruction effectively addressed thoracic adhesions in 6 cases.MethodsWe conducted a retrospective analysis of 6 patients with refractory benign esophageal fistulas treated, documenting etiology, preoperative treatment, surgical techniques, and postoperative results.ResultsThe causes were spontaneous esophageal rupture in 2 cases and iatrogenic damage in 4 cases.

pmc-13695642.title: Clinico-molecular characteristics and enhanced efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors in TP53-mutated advanced biliary tract cancer
pmc-13695642.creator: Taro Shibuki, Celine Hoyek, Ryne Ramaker, Madhuri Gottam, Makoto Ueno, Yasuyuki Kawamoto, Shinji Itoh, Kanae Inoue, Tadayoshi Hashimoto, Takao Fujisawa, Mitsuho Imai, Yoshiaki Nakamura, Hideaki Bando, Angelo Pirozzi, Binbin Zheng-Lin, Oluseyi Abidoye, Cody R. Eslinger, Mohamad Bassam Sonbol, Hani Ba
pmc-13695642.description: BackgroundTP53 mutations are among the most frequent alterations in biliary tract cancer (BTC), but their prognostic relevance and predictive value for immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICI) remain unclear. We assessed clinico-molecular features, prognosis, and ICI efficacy by TP53 status in advanced BTC.MethodsPatients with advanced BTC from Japan and the United States who underwent tissue- or plasma-based next-generation sequencing were retrospectively analyzed.
